name: Shivam Kumar
bio: I am an interdisciplinary researcher and community builder interested in exploring how emerging technologies can transform the ways we document, preserve, and experience cultural heritage. My interests span Digital Humanities, XR, digital heritage, cultural tourism, and the intersection of technology, history, and society. Through DH Nexus, an independent initiative connecting technology, humanities, and creativity, I aim to create opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovation. I am particularly interested in using immersive technologies to make cultural heritage more accessible, engaging, and meaningful.
